It’s been said that only the brave few
get powerful works of bold ambition.
Great design doesn’t just happen. It’s an exacting process that helps ensure that every design line not only
adds to the character, but also, ultimately, helps tell a compelling, cohesive story. You notice it in the way
the lines flow into the redesigned Singleframe® grille, where the wide shape and crisp, chamfered corners
create a sense of sportiness that pairs nicely with the flat lower bumper line, for an overall effect of power
and stability. The Tornado line is what really drives the plot, though. Bisecting the body profile, it runs along
the length of the vehicle, giving it a progressive contour that tells the world that there’s distinction here, not
convention. It’s the kind of memorable characteristic that brings the bold story of design to life.
2016 Audi A7 3.0T Prestige shown in Florett Silver metallic with available equipment.
